# deps/non-registry-source

New dependency from outside the registry.

A dependency added in this change that comes from a git repository (git+, github:), a tarball URL, or a file: path outside the repository, or a new lockfile entry downloaded from a host that is not a configured registry.

- Default level: `warn`.
- Levels: workspace:, catalog:, link:, and file: paths inside the repository are fine. Hosts from .npmrc, .yarnrc.yml, and .yarnrc count as configured registries.
- Looks at: what the change did, comparing each file before and after.
- References: [CWE-829](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/829.html), [CWE-494](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/494.html), OWASP A03:2025.

## Why it matters

These sources skip the registry and its checks: there is no immutable version, no publish date, and no malicious-package record to look up, and a branch or URL can serve different code tomorrow. A changed resolved URL in a lockfile is also how lockfile injection works.

## Flagged

`package-lock.json` (warn):

```json
"resolved": "https://registry.example-mirror.net/fancy-log/-/fancy-log-2.0.0.tgz",
```

`package-lock.json` (warn):

```json
"resolved": "git+ssh://git@github.com/someone/color-support.git#3333333333333333333333333333333333333333",
```

`package-lock.json` (warn):

```json
"resolved": "https://downloads.example.com/tarball-dep-1.0.0.tgz",
```

`package.json` (warn):

```json
"left-pad": "git+https://github.com/someone/left-pad.git",
```

`package.json` (warn):

```json
"tiny-lib": "someone/tiny-lib#main",
```

`package.json` (warn):

```json
"vendored": "https://example.com/vendored-1.0.0.tgz",
```

`package.json` (warn):

```json
"shared-config": "file:../../shared-config",
```

`package.json` (warn):

```json
"gen": "exec:./scripts/build-gen.js"
```

## Not flagged

- `@acme:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com` in `.npmrc`: the @acme scope comes from GitHub Packages, so its tarball URLs there are fine
- @acme/ui: downloaded from npm.pkg.github.com, the registry .npmrc sets for @acme
- cli-helper: already a git dependency at the base; only the commit changed
- chalk and react: registry.npmjs.org
- mirror-pkg: registry.yarnpkg.com serves the public npm registry
- internal-lib: already a git dependency at the base; only the ref changed
- local-ui and @web/lib: file: paths inside the repository
- design and zod: workspace: and catalog: protocols
- linked: link: to a folder inside the repository
- my-react: an npm alias, installed from the registry

## How to fix

Install the package from the registry, or pin it to a full commit hash or an integrity-checked tarball and review the code.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore deps/non-registry-source: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "deps/non-registry-source": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
